About the project

A sport that gives kids somewhere to belong

For more than 15 years, we’ve been creating opportunities for people to grow, connect, and thrive through flag football in Ukraine. We’ve used sport to build confidence, discipline, leadership, and a sense of belonging.

Our mission with this project is to make sport accessible to more children through youth programs, school partnerships, coach education, and community initiatives. As Ukraine rebuilds, this will help kids find belonging, purpose, and hope for the future.

Five-year roadmap

The drive downfield

Five seasons, moving from a single restored stadium to a self-sustaining national program — each year marked by where it lands on the field.

40
Year 1

Foundation

Restore Kastelivka Stadium, recruit young athletes, appoint an international head coach, equip teams, and expand youth training.

30
Year 2

Development

Foster youth programs through schools, certify coaches, introduce training camps, and build a youth player pathway.

20
Year 3

Regional Growth

Grow participation across the Lviv region, create more youth teams, and establish regional leagues and competitions.

10
Year 4

International Integration

Create opportunities for young athletes through global partnerships, elite development, and international competitions.

Goal
Year 5

Sustainability

Create a self-sustaining ecosystem with stable funding, annual leagues, modern facilities, and a scalable model for Ukraine.

The people behind the team

Behind every season, every game, and every decision — there are people.

Anastasiia

Anastasiia started her journey as part of the cheerleading squad.

Read moreRead less

Over time, she fell in love with the game and became a key player for both the Lviv Lions women’s team and the Ukrainian national team.

With strong athletic ability from a young age, she kept developing her skills and naturally stepped into a leadership role. In the toughest moments on the field, she takes responsibility, stays composed, and pushes her teammates to fight until the very last second.

Khrystyna

Khrystyna was the team’s photographer starting from 2015. She didn’t miss a single game.

Read moreRead less

Through the years, she fell in love with the sport — and eventually became one of the people who made it grow. She founded the women’s flag football team in Lviv, brought people together, and built a motivated group from scratch.

Her ability to unite and inspire others turned a group of individuals into a real team.

Miia

Miia is one of the strongest players not only in Ukraine, but also in Europe.

Read moreRead less

A true leader on the field, she also took responsibility off the field. While recovering from a serious injury that forced her to miss the European Championship, she enrolled in a university of physical culture and sports to gain the knowledge needed to manage and develop both the club and the federation.

At the same time, she helped establish a regional federation and took on an organizational role in growing the sport. She represents the heart and resilience of the team — someone who keeps moving forward no matter the circumstances.

Markiian

Markiian has been the team’s quarterback for 16 seasons.

Read moreRead less

He has seen it all — tough losses, big wins, and everything in between. Today, he focuses not only on playing, but also on coaching the next generation.

He shares his experience, helps develop young players, and works on improving the club’s structure and training process. His goal is simple — bring more people into the sport and keep the team growing.

Viktor

Viktor has been involved in sports since childhood, but it was American football where he truly found his place.

Read moreRead less

He developed into a leader both in the club and on the national team, showing how consistent hard work can shape a complete athlete.

Able to play on both sides of the ball, he sets the tone at practices and keeps everyone focused on the bigger goal. He’s one of the driving forces behind the team’s daily work.

Oksana

Oksana has been the quarterback of the women’s team for six seasons and is also part of the Ukrainian national flag football team.

Read moreRead less

She was never naturally gifted athletically, and every step of her progress came through discipline, consistency, and constant work on herself. She first discovered flag football through her husband, who was already part of the team at the time. What started as curiosity quickly became a huge part of her life.

For most of her journey, she developed without having long-term coaching support. She worked with a dedicated quarterback coach for only one year, which is very little for such a complex position. Because of that, she had to take on much more responsibility herself, not only improving her own game but also leading and managing the women’s team on the field from a tactical and leadership perspective.

Working in the IT industry and having experience with international collaboration and partnerships also allowed her to contribute to the club beyond the field. She actively helps develop connections, partnerships, and opportunities that support the growth of both the team and flag football in Lviv and across the region.
